{{CharInfobox |color={{Hoenn color}} |corecolor={{Hoenn color light}} |bordercolor={{Hoenn color dark}} |name=Lanette |jname=マユミ |tmname=Mayumi |image=Lanette ORAS OD.png |size=200px |caption=Overworld model from {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |gender=Female |hometown={{rt|114|Hoenn}} |relatives=[[Brigette]] (older sister) |region=[[Hoenn]] |game=yes |generation={{gen|III}}, {{gen|VI}} |games={{game3|Ruby and Sapphire|Ruby, Sapphire|s}}, {{v2|Emerald}}, {{pkmn|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, Alpha Sapphire}} }} '''Lanette''' (Japanese: '''マユミ''' ''Mayumi'') is a computer technician and the younger sister of [[Brigette]]. She lives in a house on {{rt|114|Hoenn}} near [[Fallarbor Town]] and is the maintainer of Hoenn's [[Pokémon Storage System]]. She first appears in {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}} and reappears in {{game|Emerald}} and {{g|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}}. ==In the games== [[File:Lanettehouse.png|thumb|Lanette in Pokémon Emerald]] [[File:Lanette ORAS.png|thumb|200px|Lanette in Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]] As an expert in computing, Lanette has created the [[Pokémon Storage System]] in [[Hoenn]]. Unlike [[Bill]]'s, who had created the original Pokémon Storage System in [[Kanto]] and [[Johto]], Lanette's provides a user-friendly graphical {{wp|user interface|interface}} and the ability to store more Pokémon and change the {{DL|Pokémon Storage System|wallpaper}} of the Boxes in which Pokémon are stored. She is the younger sister of [[Bridgette]]. In an email in {{3v2|Ruby|Sapphire|Emerald}}, she is implied to know Bill, but {{g|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} removes the mention of his name in the email. Lanette is first met at the [[Pokémon Center]] in [[Fallarbor Town]], currently using the PC storage system. She apologizes for getting in the way and leaves to her house on {{rt|114|Hoenn}}. In order for her to appear at her house, the player must speak to her at the Pokémon Center. When arriving at her house, the player finds that it is greatly cluttered. She claims it gets that way when she is engrossed in her research. In return for keeping this a secret, she gives the {{player}} a {{p|Seedot}}{{sup/3|Ru}}{{sup/6|OR}} or {{p|Lotad}}{{sup/3|Sa}}{{sup/3|E}}{{sup/6|AS}} {{pkmn|doll}}. In Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, the player can speak with Lanette to change the order of options in Lanette's PC, bringing "Organize Boxes" from the third option to the first and pushing "Deposit Pokémon" and "Withdraw Pokémon" to the second and third options, respectively. Speaking with her again can undo the change. {{left clear}} ===Quotes=== ====Pokémon Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald==== ;{{to|Fallarbor}} [[Pokémon Center]] : ''"Oh, hello. You are? Okay, your name's . {{color2|000000|Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire}} |} |} ==In the manga== {{incomplete|section|Missing information about her Swablu in Pokémon Adventures}} ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Adventures storage system developers.png|thumb|250px|Lanette with [[Brigette]], [[Bill]], and [[Celio]] in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===== Lanette and her sister went to [[Kanto]] to upgrade its [[Pokémon Storage System]] and make it compatible with the one in [[Hoenn]]. This allowed [[Pokémon Trainer]]s to move Pokémon between the two [[region]]s. She and Brigette were the ones to suggest a similarity in {{p|Castform}} and {{adv|Deoxys}}'s required conditions for changing [[form]]s. This information came in handy for {{adv|Red}}; he and {{adv|Mewtwo}} later fought Deoxys after it was {{pkmn2|caught}} by {{adv|Giovanni}}. ====={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===== In ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'', she and her sister made a cameo appearance in one of the ships heading to the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== She and her sister was mentioned by Bill in ''[[PS607|Blastoise Transforms]]'', where they had been investigating the origin of the {{i|Ruby}} and {{i|Sapphire}} to no avail. ====Pokémon==== {| width="25%" |- | {{ActivePoké|Lanette|Swablu|Lanette Swablu Adventures.png|normal|flying|link=no|size=200px}} |} ==In the TCG== [[Image:Lanette TCG.png|thumb|right|230px|Artwork from TCG]] This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Lanette or her services in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. {{cardlist/header|Lanette|Trainer|char=yes}} {{cardlist/entry|cardname={{TCG ID|EX Sandstorm|Lanette's Net Search|87}}|type=Trainer|type2=Supporter|enset=EX Sandstorm|enrarity=Uncommon|ennum=87/100|jpset=Miracle of the Desert|jprarity=Uncommon|jpnum=051/053|enset2=EX Emerald|enrarity2=Uncommon|ennum2=77/106}} {{cardlist/footer|Trainer}} ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{Hoenn color}}; border:3px solid #{{Hoenn color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{Hoenn color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{Hoenn color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{Hoenn color light}}" | Origin |- |Japanese | マユミ ''Mayumi'' | From 檀 ''mayumi'' ({{wp|Euonymus hamiltonianus|Hamilton's spindletree}}) |- | English, German, Italian | Lanette | From ''{{wp|Local area network|LAN}}'' and ''{{wp|Computer network|net}}'' |- | European Spanish | Aredia | From ''red'' (network) |- | French | Annette | From ''net'' |- | rowspan="2" | Korean | 보은 ''Bo-eun''[[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]]
